verdict.rationale: Circle Mint lets qualified businesses convert USD to/from USDC (circle-docs-13), and CPN documents cross-border fiat payouts settled in USDC (circle-docs-12), showing fiat↔stablecoin movement is supported. However, evidence lacks concrete API reference detail or dashboard walkthrough for internal transfers/rebalancing as a documented end-to-end flow — missing for 10: explicit API endpoints/parameters for fiat-stablecoin conversion, dashboard UI documentation, and independent confirmation of the rebalancing workflow.
